glosses: to be confined to bed (with an illness)
to go bankrupt (of a company, bank, etc.)
to fall (of a government, dictator, etc.)

exampleTranslations.1: He fell flat on the floor.
exampleTranslations.2: My father fell ill because he worked too hard.
exampleTranslations.3: He was cut down in his prime.
exampleTranslations.6: They say that the cabinet will fall.
